payload.title: Method overview
payload.description: This notebook recreates Figure 1 from the original publication, presenting an overview of the LERM analysis technique. It focuses on setting up the environment, configuring font sizes, and using Pyleoclim to load necessary data.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data visualization and analysis. Suppress warnings for presentation purposes, although this is not recommended as a best practice.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Suppress Warnings

steps.description: Set default font sizes for various elements of the figure, including axes titles, labels, and tick labels, to ensure clarity and presentation quality.
steps.title: Configure Font Sizes

steps.description: Utilize the Pyleoclim library to load the necessary data for recreating Figure 1.
steps.title: Load Data Using Pyleoclim
